name: Mondelez International
outlook:
What Mondelez International says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue, EPS and cash flowFor 2026, the company reaffirms Organic Net Revenue growth of at least 2 percent and Adjusted EPS growth in the range of flat to 5 percent on a constant currency basis. The company also expects 2026 Free Cash Flow of approximately $3 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
